prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production asset: faithful HD animation artwork for Sam & Max Hit the Road (1993), costume 97 in room 22, Tunnel of Love.

Image 1 is the exact ORIGINAL POSE ATLAS to redraw. Images 2 and 3 are approved Sam and Max master sheets for the same character design, ink and color treatment ONLY. The original atlas overrides a master's pose, framing and temporary gag colors. Do not render the master sheets. The slate gray background is padding and must become genuine transparent alpha.

Redraw exactly 5 complete separate source drawings on ONE 1536 x 1024 transparent canvas. Use the same 3 columns by 2 rows of 512 x 512 cells as image 1, left to right then top to bottom. Keep unused cells completely empty. Each original in its same cell and same position; ample transparent gaps between drawings. No labels, numbers, cell borders or background. Do not merge/split drawings or repeat a single pose to replace different frames.

SOURCE MEANING AND PHASE: This is the recovery sequence, exactly as pictured: first Max still has a black head and limp black ears while spreading his arms; next two frames show his long ears springing upward as the black coating clears unevenly to cream with pink inner ears; last two frames are deliberate HEAD-SHAKING MULTIPLE EXPOSURES: several overlapping outlines of the SAME rabbit head and ears, small black soot specks, a little red mouth/tongue. Keep the exact differing afterimage shape in each of the last two drawings. Sam holds Max at waist level at his left throughout; do not normalize all heads to a clean standing master pose. No boat.

Faithfulness: trace the exact silhouette, proportions and internal geometry of every source, keeping head/torso size ratio, hats, muzzles, eyes, hands, grins and all overlaps. Turn each pixel cluster into the smooth drawn shape it represents. Same size and same viewing angle. Preserve partial drawings exactly; do not complete absent bodies. Clean dark continuous anti-aliased ink, flat clean colors with one shade and a few small highlights, same area colors as the original, same identity and line weight as approved masters. No pixel blocks, staircase edges, dithering, grain, texture, blur, gradients, photorealism or 3D. Do not enlarge heads, eyes, ears or hands relative to bodies. Keep the source's visible small disconnected motion marks; do not add decorative debris or glow.

Cell order and eventual source-size at 4x (not a license to fill the cell): 1: 1933, 228 x 212 HD pixels, 2: 1934, 268 x 292 HD pixels, 3: 1935, 240 x 292 HD pixels, 4: 1936, 300 x 296 HD pixels, 5: 1937, 296 x 296 HD pixels. The atlas is temporarily magnified for painting; final entire drawings will be placed at fixed 4x with their own soft alpha. Do not change relative shape to use empty cell space.

Output ONE 1536 x 1024 RGBA image with real transparent background. No boat unless this source explicitly includes one, no scenery, floor shadows, words, watermark or signature.
